discharges.text:
Wellness and vaccines

Medications To Go Home
{Medications · dispensed today}
Give each medication exactly as the label says and finish the full course, even if {Patient name} seems better.

Diet
Keep feeding {Patient name}'s usual food. We can talk about any changes in weight or diet at the next visit.

Exercise
Quiet time today if {Patient name} seems tired. Normal activity can start tomorrow.

Special Instructions
Mild soreness, tiredness or a smaller appetite can be normal for a day or two. A small lump at the injection site can last a few weeks. Call us if it lasts longer than that or keeps growing.
Vaccines given today: {Vaccines given today}.
Due soon: {SOC due within 45 days}.
Puppies and kittens are not fully protected until their vaccine series is finished, so avoid dog parks and unknown animals until then.
This is an emergency: call {Clinic phone} right away for facial swelling, hives, repeated vomiting, collapse or trouble breathing.
Next appointment: {Next appointment date} {Next appointment time}.

Success with any treatment is a combination of what we do, what {Patient name} does, and what you do before, during, and after a visit. Please follow the instructions outlined and call {Clinic phone} if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for choosing {Clinic name}.
